ValidationRule.description: Prevent opportunity from going to any prior stage
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISCHANGED(StageName), NOT( ISPICKVAL(StageName, "Cancelled") || ISPICKVAL(StageName, "Transfered") ), CASE( PRIORVALUE(StageName), "Sold", 3, "Reserved", 2, "Booked", 1, 0 ) > CASE( StageName, "Sold", 3, "Reserved", 2, "Booked", 1, 0 ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: You cannot move to prior stage. Please contact your System Administrator
